4400.name: The Sunless Lands

west.description: To the west lies The Catacombs.

4400.description:
A lightless nothing presses in on every side, with no floor to feel and
no wall to lean on. Cold and stillness are all there is, and even your
own heartbeat sounds muffled and far away. Whatever prayers once drew
you toward this blackness have left no mark upon it, and no way out can
be found.

4401.name: Outside The Cathedral

north.description: To the north lies On The Concourse.

east.description: To the east lies The Path By The Cathedral.

south.description: To the south lies The Antechamber.

west.description: To the west lies The Path By The Cathedral.

4401.description:
Before the great doors of the abandoned cathedral the paving is cracked
and sunken, and lichen creeps up the broad steps. A tall pointed porch
looms overhead, its carved saints worn faceless by weather. Back north
lies the Concourse and the last smoke and noise of Garathorm, while a
path curls away east and west around the cathedral's walls. The doors to
the south stand ajar upon the dusty dark of the antechamber.

4402.name: The Path By The Cathedral

east.description: To the east lies Outside The Cathedral.

south.description: To the south lies The Side Of The Cathedral.

4402.description:
This is the cathedral's outer flank, where the path squeezes between the
buttresses and a wall of dark ivy. Stained glass high above has lost
most of its panes, and a few coloured shards still glint dully in the
lead. East the way returns to the great doors, and south the path runs
along the side of the church. Everything smells of damp stone and
rotting leaves.

4403.name: The Path By The Cathedral

south.description: To the south lies On The Shaded Path.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Cathedral.

4403.description:
The path runs tight beside the cathedral's flank, where flying
buttresses lean over it and old yew boughs shut out the sky. Moss has
turned the flagstones into a soft green carpet that muffles every step.
West the way opens toward the cathedral's porch, and south it slips off
along a shaded track under darker trees. A cold draught seeps out of the
stonework beside you.

4404.name: The Side Of The Cathedral

north.description: To the north lies The Path By The Cathedral.

east.description: To the east lies The Hall.

south.description: To the south lies The Churchyard.

4404.description:
A narrow strip of ground runs between the cathedral wall and the yard,
closed in by buttresses and the dripping eaves. East a low arched door,
its oak gone silver, leads into the cathedral itself. The path goes on
north toward the front of the church, and south it opens among the
graves. Weeds sprout in every crack of the paving, and the stones are
slick with green.

4405.name: On The Shaded Path

north.description: To the north lies The Path By The Cathedral.

south.description: To the south lies The Churchyard.

4405.description:
Yews and black cypresses meet overhead, and the path beneath is only a
strip of damp earth between tilted headstones. The light here is green
and weak, and the air smells of wet leaves and old stone. North the path
winds back toward the cathedral wall, while ahead to the south the
leaning graves of the churchyard begin in earnest.

4406.name: The Churchyard

north.description: To the north lies The Side Of The Cathedral.

east.description: To the east lies The Churchyard.

south.description: To the south lies The Churchyard.

west.description: To the west lies In The Mausoleum.

4406.description:
The cathedral's grey side wall rises close to the north here, streaked
black where the gutters long ago gave up. Beneath it the graves are
older and the stones lower, half swallowed by nettles. West stands a
squat mausoleum with a heavy door set into its face, and the yard runs
on east and south. A cold smell of wax drifts faintly from somewhere
inside the church.

4407.name: The Churchyard

east.description: To the east lies The Churchyard.

south.description: To the south lies The Churchyard.

west.description: To the west lies The Churchyard.

4407.description:
A broken angel kneels on a plinth at the heart of this corner of the
yard, her wings snapped and her folded hands worn to stumps. Ivy has
wound itself around her shoulders as though to hold her up. Graves
stretch east and west of her, and the ground slopes down south toward
the tombs. The sky above is a pale smear behind the bare branches.

extra_descs.angel statue:
The kneeling angel's face is gone, chiselled flat by wind and rain. A
faint line of letters runs along her plinth, but only the word 'rest'
can still be made out.

4408.name: The Churchyard

north.description: To the north lies On The Shaded Path.

east.description: To the east lies The Field.

south.description: To the south lies The Churchyard.

west.description: To the west lies The Churchyard.

4408.description:
Crooked headstones crowd the grass here, many of them sunk to their
shoulders in the turf and wearing names that no one can read. A trodden
path leads north under the trees, and the ground opens east into a rough
field. More graves run on to the south and west in untidy rows. A wind
picks at the dry grass with a sound like whispering.

4409.name: The Churchyard

north.description: To the north lies The Churchyard.

east.description: To the east lies The Churchyard.

4409.description:
The graves here lie close together, their headstones fallen forward like
a row of dominoes. A cracked urn on a pedestal stands stained and empty,
and nettles grow thick where the wind has piled dead leaves. North, a
line of older stones runs toward the cathedral wall, and east the yard
continues past a sunken path. A sour smell of wet earth hangs in the
shade.

4410.name: The Churchyard

north.description: To the north lies The Churchyard.

east.description: To the east lies The Churchyard.

south.description: To the south lies In The Mausoleum.

west.description: To the west lies The Churchyard.

4410.description:
Here the graves stand in tidy rows, though the rows have heaved and
slumped until each stone points a different way. Iron railings, rusted
to lace, fence off a few of the older plots. To the south rises the
squat grey front of a mausoleum, its bronze door green with age. The
grass is trampled flat along the path that leads to it.

4411.name: The Churchyard

north.description: To the north lies The Churchyard.

west.description: To the west lies The Churchyard.

4411.description:
A cluster of table tombs squats in the long grass, their lids split by
the roots of an old yew that twists up out of one of them. Moss greys
every inscription, and the carved skulls on the corners have lost their
faces. The yard climbs gently north to a wider stretch of graves, and a
row of smaller markers runs off west. Dew never seems to leave the
stone.

4412.name: In The Mausoleum

east.description: To the east lies The Churchyard.

down.description: To the down lies The Vault.

4412.description:
A small, domed mausoleum, its walls bearing the names of a long-dead
family in raised letters worn by many winters. Three empty stone coffins
stand open in the middle of the floor. The way east leads out to the
churchyard, and a trapdoor at your feet drops into the vault below. Weak
daylight slants in, grey and thin.

4413.name: In The Mausoleum

north.description: To the north lies The Churchyard.

down.description: To the down lies The Vault.

4413.description:
The mausoleum stands cold and hushed, its walls lined with marble
plaques and its floor strewn with dead leaves blown in under the door. A
stone coffin rests on a dais in the centre, its lid shifted a hand's
breadth to one side. The door north opens upon the churchyard, and a
hatch in the floor drops to the vault below. Cold seeps from the marble.

extra_descs.coffin dais:
The stone coffin is carved with the likeness of a robed priest, his
hands crossed upon his breast. The lid has been shoved aside, and
something inside has been long since taken.

4414.name: The Field

north.description: To the north lies The Gate.

west.description: To the west lies The Churchyard.

4414.description:
The graves give out here and rank meadow grass takes over, waist-high
and grey with seed. North, an iron gate hangs shut in a hedge of thorn,
chained fast and thick with creeper, and nothing beyond it can be seen.
Back west the headstones of the churchyard lean together like gossips.
The wind is steady across the open ground and carries a smell of turned
earth.

4415.name: The Antechamber

east.description: To the east lies The Antechamber.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Hall.

up.description: To the up lies The Gallery.

4415.description:
A low stone antechamber, cold as a cellar, where worshippers once shook
the rain from their cloaks. A spiral stair of worn steps winds upward in
the corner toward the galleries. East the room continues, and south a
heavy door opens into the hall. Hooks line the walls for cloaks nobody
will ever hang, and a thin line of dust marks the floor.

4416.name: The Antechamber

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Cathedral.

east.description: To the east lies The Antechamber.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Hall.

west.description: To the west lies The Antechamber.

4416.description:
This is the main entrance of the cathedral, a broad stone chamber with a
high roof and a floor scattered with leaves blown in through the cracks.
The great doors stand to the north, barred with tarnished iron and grey
with cobweb. West and east the antechamber continues, and south the hall
opens on its fallen pews. Holy-water stoups beside the doors are dry and
cracked.

4417.name: The Antechamber

south.description: To the south lies The Great Hall.

west.description: To the west lies The Antechamber.

up.description: To the up lies The Gallery.

4417.description:
A cramped end of the antechamber, where a stone font of dry, cracked
marble stands against the wall. An iron-railed stair climbs up from the
corner toward the galleries, its rail slick with grime. West the
entrance chamber lies open, and south a door leads down into the hall. A
single shaft of grey light falls through a crack in the roof.

4418.name: The Great Hall

north.description: To the north lies The Antechamber.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Hall.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Hall.

west.description: To the west lies The Secret Alcove.

4418.description:
Slim pillars rise from the dust-thick floor to a ceiling lost in gloom,
and between them the fallen pews lie in drifts. A heavy door stands
closed to the north, leading into the antechamber, and a narrow panelled
door in the west wall is half hidden behind a toppled lectern. The hall
opens east and south. Candle-wax, long dead, has run down the pillars in
pale ridges.

4419.name: The Great Hall

north.description: To the north lies The Antechamber.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Hall.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Hall.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Hall.

down.description: To the down lies The Bottom Of The Well.

4419.description:
A round stone well-curb breaks the floor of the nave here, its iron
cover long since rusted through and its dark throat open. A cold breath
rises from it, smelling of old water and mud. The hall continues east,
south and west of here, and the antechamber lies through a door to the
north. Chains hang from a beam above the well like a dead creeper.

4420.name: The Great Hall

north.description: To the north lies The Antechamber.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Hall.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Hall.

4420.description:
Along this side of the hall the pews stand in better order, though every
one has sagged on rotten legs. Dust lies thick on the floor, unbroken by
any print but your own. North a door leads back into the antechamber,
and the hall runs on south and west. Somewhere far off a bell tolls
once, faint and thin, and the silence swallows the echo.

4421.name: The Hall

east.description: To the east lies The Great Hall.

west.description: To the west lies The Side Of The Cathedral.

4421.description:
A short vaulted passage connects the side door to the nave, its floor of
black and white tiles gone dull under years of grit. Empty sconces line
the walls, their iron arms crusted with old wax. West is the door to the
outer path, and east the passage opens upon the great hall. A faint,
cold, sweetish smell hangs in the stillness.

4422.name: The Great Hall

north.description: To the north lies The Great Hall.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Hall.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Hall.

west.description: To the west lies The Hall.

4422.description:
You stand at the western edge of the great hall, where the pews begin.
They lie in splintered ranks, toppled and heaped, with prayer-books
rotted into grey pulp on the shelves. Ahead the nave runs on east, and
the hall continues both north and south of here. Far above, the roof
timbers vanish into a darkness that echoes with every scuff of your
boots.

4423.name: The Great Hall

north.description: To the north lies The Great Hall.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Hall.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Hall.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Hall.

4423.description:
Directly above, the great rose window gapes broken, its tracery bare and
spiked with the last coloured shards. Pale light falls through in
slanted bars, picking out drifting dust. Here the hall runs in all four
directions, between toppled pillars and heaped pews. A cold, slow
draught circles in the nave.

extra_descs.rose window:
The tracery of the rose window forms twelve great petals, now empty of
almost all their glass. A few ruby and sapphire shards cling to the lead
like dried petals.

4424.name: The Great Hall

north.description: To the north lies The Great Hall.

east.description: To the east lies The Sacristy.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Hall.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Hall.

4424.description:
A heavy oak door in the east wall leads to the sacristy, its handle worn
bright by long years of priestly hands. The pews here lie in a tangle
against the wall where something once dragged them. The hall continues
north, south and west of here. Rushlight stubs sit crusted in iron
brackets, and the floor tiles show cracks wide as a thumb.

4425.name: The Alcove

east.description: To the east lies The Great Hall.

4425.description:
A shallow alcove behind the pews, its back wall painted with a faded
fresco of kneeling saints, their haloes flaked away to bare plaster. A
stone bench runs along the wall, polished by the knees of long-dead
penitents. The hall lies east. The air is musty and cold, and the paint
dust crunches under foot.

4426.name: The Great Hall

north.description: To the north lies The Great Hall.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Hall.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Hall.

west.description: To the west lies The Alcove.

4426.description:
The pews stand in ragged lines along this side, their kneelers gnawed by
damp and time. A grey alcove opens in the west wall behind a curtain of
cobweb, and the nave continues north, east and south. The flagstones are
cracked by the roots of something that has found its way under the
church. A smell of stale incense lingers.

4427.name: The Great Hall

north.description: To the north lies The Great Hall.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Hall.

south.description: To the south lies By The Diamond Altar.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Hall.

4427.description:
Here the nave widens before the altar steps, and the fallen pews lie in
a litter of broken kneelers and splintered backs. Brass candlesticks,
green and bent, lie among the wreckage. Light from the west and south
catches the glitter of the altar beyond. The hall runs north, east and
west, and the altar waits to the south.

4428.name: The Great Hall

north.description: To the north lies The Great Hall.

east.description: To the east lies The Secret Stairwell.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Hall.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Hall.

4428.description:
A small door in the east wall of the hall leads into the wall's hidden
stair, its panels so cleverly cut that they pass for part of the stone.
The pews here are stacked against one another, as though cleared away in
a hurry. The hall runs on north, south and west. A faded tapestry hangs
by a single corner above the door.

4429.name: The Great Hall

north.description: To the north lies The Great Hall.

east.description: To the east lies By The Diamond Altar.

down.description: To the down lies The Catacombs.

4429.description:
In a far corner of the hall, a great trapdoor of black oak has been
wrenched half open, revealing a stair of slick stone plunging down. A
raw cold pours up from it, smelling of earth and old bones. The hall
runs north and east, and the stair leads down into the dark. Scratches
on the flags mark where heavy things were dragged.

4430.name: By The Diamond Altar

north.description: To the north lies The Great Hall.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Hall.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Hall.

4430.description:
The diamond altar stands at the heart of the great hall, a block of
clear crystal as high as your waist, throwing cold light in every
direction. Candle-stubs ring its foot in a melted crown, and the
flagstones around it are scuffed by a thousand kneeling years. The hall
opens north, east and west around it. A deep hush hangs here, as though
the altar kept a vigil of its own.

extra_descs.diamond altar:
The altar is a single flawless crystal, uncut and faintly luminous,
without a seam or a flaw. Its heart shows dark shapes, like figures in a
frozen pool, and the cold it gives off stings the fingers.

4431.name: The Great Hall

north.description: To the north lies The Great Hall.

west.description: To the west lies By The Diamond Altar.

4431.description:
This far corner of the great hall is hung with rotting banners, their
stitching unravelled. A glitter breaks the gloom to the west, where the
altar stands. North the hall continues along the wall, and the
flagstones are polished by a faint shine. Dust lies here as thick as
snowfall.

4432.name: The Secret Alcove

east.description: To the east lies The Great Hall.

4432.description:
A hidden alcove, hardly more than a closet, built into the thickness of
the wall behind the panelling. A narrow shelf holds an old stub of
candle and a heap of crumbled parchment. Cold dust fills every corner,
and the stone sweats. The only way out is the door east, leading back to
the great hall.

4433.name: The Sacristy

south.description: To the south lies The Back Room.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Hall.

4433.description:
The sacristy is a narrow room of cedar cupboards and a long vestment
table, everything furred with dust. Stained cloth, once crimson and
gold, hangs in rotting folds from open drawers. West is the door back to
the hall, and a plain door to the south leads on to a back room. The air
is thick with the smell of old incense gone sour.

4434.name: The Back Room

north.description: To the north lies The Sacristy.

down.description: To the down lies The Catacombs.

4434.description:
A small back room, bare but for a scarred table and a rack of empty
candle-holders on the wall. The floor boards near the far corner have
been pulled up, revealing a stair of rough stone that drops away into
cold darkness. North lies the sacristy, and the stairwell leads down
toward something older. The silence in here is absolute and watchful.

4435.name: The Secret Stairwell

west.description: To the west lies The Great Hall.

up.description: To the up lies On The Roof.

down.description: To the down lies The Secret Passage.

4435.description:
A cramped spiral stair of wedge-cut stone winds through the thickness of
the cathedral's wall, lit by nothing but a thin seam of daylight from
above. The steps are hollowed with age, and the central pillar is carved
with faint, spidery runes. Up above, a hatch leads to the roof, a stair
descends into cold dark, and a door in the west wall opens on the great
hall. The air smells of tar and dust.

4436.name: The Bottom Of The Well

south.description: To the south lies The Secret Passage.

4436.description:
You are at the bottom of an old well, its walls of green-slimed stone
rising out of reach into darkness. The floor is a shallow bed of silt,
long since dry. A low opening in the wall leads out through a door
behind you. Far above, the circle of the sky is no more than a pale
coin.

4437.name: The Secret Passage

north.description: To the north lies The Bottom Of The Well.

west.description: To the west lies The Secret Passage.

up.description: To the up lies The Secret Stairwell.

4437.description:
A narrow passage hidden behind the panelling, cut straight through the
old foundations. The walls are bare stone, unpainted, and the air is
dank. A door to the north is set into the rock, a stair climbs up into
the church, and the passage continues west. Footprints in the dust have
long since been covered by new dust.

4438.name: The Secret Passage

north.description: To the north lies The Secret Passage.

east.description: To the east lies The Secret Passage.

4438.description:
A cramped, winding passage running through the wall of the church, so
narrow that your shoulders brush both sides. Cobwebs hang in thick
curtains, and the stone is slick with condensation. The way leads north
to a landing, and east it returns to the stair. Behind the panelling,
muffled, the cathedral's emptiness seems to listen.

4439.name: The Gallery

east.description: To the east lies Under The Belfry.

south.description: To the south lies By The Huge Organ.

west.description: To the west lies The Secret Passage.

down.description: To the down lies The Antechamber.

4439.description:
The gallery runs along the upper edge of the great hall, a balcony of
dark wood with a carved balustrade splintered in places. Below, the
ranks of ruined pews are barely visible in the gloom. The gallery goes
on east toward the belfry stair and south toward a vast organ, and a
hidden door in the west wall leads into the walls. A stair spirals down
at your back.

4440.name: By The Huge Organ

north.description: To the north lies The Gallery.

east.description: To the east lies The Gallery.

4440.description:
The huge organ towers here against the wall, its pipes of tarnished tin
rising into the gloom like the trunks of a petrified wood. Its keys are
yellowed and cracked, and a faded hymn-board still stands on the music
desk. The gallery passes by to the north and east. A faint, hollow note
breathes from the pipes whenever the draught moves.

extra_descs.huge organ pipes:
The pipes are tarnished and bent, some as thick as a man's body. Their
mouths are choked with dust, but a breath of air still draws a low note
from them.

4441.name: The Gallery

north.description: To the north lies Under The Belfry.

west.description: To the west lies By The Huge Organ.

down.description: To the down lies The Antechamber.

4441.description:
The gallery ends here in a corner of the church's upper floor, with
narrow windows that let in grey slats of light. Dust lies thick on the
rail, unmarked by any hand. The way north leads on toward the belfry
stair, west to the organ, and a stair spirals down to the antechamber.
The air tastes of cold wax and old paper.

4442.name: Under The Belfry

south.description: To the south lies The Gallery.

west.description: To the west lies The Gallery.

up.description: To the up lies The Belfry.

4442.description:
The belfry's timber stair rises overhead in a tight spiral, and from up
above, the great bell's rope hangs in a slow, small sway. Wooden beams
crowd close, scored with the marks of carpenters long dead. The gallery
lies west and south of here, and the stair climbs up toward the bell.
Now and then a faint, wooden creak answers from the dark.

4443.name: The Secret Passage

east.description: To the east lies The Gallery.

south.description: To the south lies The Secret Passage.

up.description: To the up lies On The Roof.

4443.description:
A hidden landing behind the cathedral's panelling, where a narrow stair
climbs up into the open air over the roof. Thin cracks of light show
between the boards at your side, and dust drifts down in the beams. A
hidden door east opens into the gallery, and the secret passage descends
south. The air smells of tar and old timber.

4444.name: On The Roof

east.description: To the east lies On The Roof.

south.description: To the south lies On The Roof.

up.description: To the up lies On The Side Of The Tower.

down.description: To the down lies The Secret Passage.

4444.description:
You stand upon the roof where the tower rises, a squat block of stone
with a rusted iron ladder bolted to its face. Below, a trapdoor of
rotted planks covers a hidden stair. The roof stretches away east and
south, and the iron rungs climb up toward the belfry. The wind is cold
and tastes of soot and rain.

4445.name: On The Roof

south.description: To the south lies On The Roof.

west.description: To the west lies On The Roof.

up.description: To the up lies On The Side Of The Tower.

4445.description:
A steep roof of lichen-crusted slate slopes away on every side, with
lead gutters choked by years of moss. Tufts of grass sprout in the
valleys between the gables, and the wind sings thinly through the
chimneys. The roof continues south and west, and a ladder of iron rungs
rises up the tower wall behind you. Beyond the parapet the graves look
small as seed.

4446.name: On The Roof

north.description: To the north lies On The Roof.

south.description: To the south lies On The Roof.

4446.description:
A long valley of lead runs between two ridges of slate, thick with
fallen leaves and blown dust. A cracked gargoyle crouches at the edge of
the gutter, its snarl worn smooth by the rain. The ridge climbs north
toward the tower, and the valley falls away south. Overhead the clouds
drift slowly, grey on grey.

4447.name: On The Roof

north.description: To the north lies On The Roof.

south.description: To the south lies On The Roof.

down.description: To the down lies The Secret Stairwell.

4447.description:
A flat stretch of lead roofing lies between two steep pitches, pocked
and green and hot to the touch at midday. A square hatch of oak, bound
with iron, is set into the leads and leads down into the church. The
roof runs on north and south from here. A cold wind off the plains blows
steadily, bringing a smell of rain.

4448.name: On The Roof

north.description: To the north lies On The Roof.

east.description: To the east lies On The Roof.

4448.description:
The slates are loose here, cracked and slipping, and a patch of rotting
timber shows where part of the roof has given way. The wind whips round
the stonework with a low moaning. You can go north along the ridge or
east across the leads. Far across the valley, the city wall of Garathorm
is a thin grey line on the horizon.

4449.name: On The Roof

north.description: To the north lies On The Roof.

west.description: To the west lies On The Roof.

4449.description:
The roof ends against a stone parapet, its crenellations broken like bad
teeth. Beyond the edge lies a drop to the churchyard, whose crooked
stones seem to nod. The slates run back north and the ridge continues
west. Rain has left black stains on every surface, and the lichen here
is the colour of old rust.

4451.name: On The Side Of The Tower

east.description: To the east lies The Belfry.

down.description: To the down lies On The Roof.

4451.description:
A narrow ledge of weathered stone clings to the tower's outer face, with
the iron ladder bolted beside it. Gusts press you against the wall, and
loose mortar trickles down at each step. East an opening in the belfry
offers a way inside, and the rungs lead down to the roof. The land far
below is a patchwork of green and grey.

4452.name: The Belfry

east.description: To the east lies On The Side Of The Tower.

west.description: To the west lies On The Side Of The Tower.

down.description: To the down lies Under The Belfry.

4452.description:
The great bell hangs in its oaken frame, green with age and dull with
dust. Louvred openings in the walls let a cold wind whistle through, and
the rope sways gently without a hand upon it. A narrow ledge runs out on
either side onto the outside of the tower, east and west, and the stair
descends below. The whole tower hums with the ghost of old tolling.

extra_descs.great bell:
The bell is cast with a band of saints and a date too corroded to read.
Its clapper has been tied back with rotted cord, yet now and then it
stirs by itself.

4453.name: On The Side Of The Tower

west.description: To the west lies The Belfry.

down.description: To the down lies On The Roof.

4453.description:
You cling to the outer wall of the tower, where a narrow ledge of
weathered stone runs beside the open belfry. Wind tugs at your clothes,
and the graveyard and the grey countryside lie spread out far below.
West the louvred opening of the belfry offers shelter, and a ladder of
iron rungs descends toward the roof. Moss and dark streaks stain the
stone.

4454.name: The Catacombs

east.description: To the east lies The Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies The Catacombs.

4454.description:
Burial niches line the walls in rows, each narrow slot sealed with a
flat slab and a name scratched in the lime. The air is cold and dry and
carries a faint smell of old dust and older rot. A tunnel leads east,
and the vault of the catacombs runs on south. Water drips somewhere in
the dark, steady as a slow pulse.

4455.name: The Catacombs

south.description: To the south lies The Catacombs.

west.description: To the west lies The Tunnel.

up.description: To the up lies The Secret Passage.

4455.description:
The catacomb passage widens into a long chamber lined with burial
niches, many of them broken open and their stone lids lying cracked on
the floor. A cold current of air moves through the place, smelling of
earth and old candle smoke. West the way leads into a plain tunnel,
south the passage runs on, and above you a gap in the ceiling opens onto
a hidden stair.

4456.name: The Catacombs

north.description: To the north lies The Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies The Junction.

4456.description:
The catacomb opens here into a hall of low arches, supported by thick
stone piers carved with weeping faces. Between the piers the burial
niches are choked with dust and the dust with cobweb. A passage leads
north into a narrow tunnel, and south the hall ends at a junction of
ways. A smell of old stone and cold wax hangs unmoving.

4457.name: The Junction

north.description: To the north lies The Catacombs.

east.description: To the east lies The Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies The Vault.

west.description: To the west lies The Vault.

4457.description:
Four ways meet in this junction hall, each framed by an arch of black
stone. A door of studded oak stands to the south, and a plainer archway
opens west into a vault, while a tunnel leads east and the catacomb
passage runs north. Faded runes ring the ceiling in a circle too worn to
read. The air is bitterly cold.

4458.name: The Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies The Large Cave.

west.description: To the west lies The Junction.

4458.description:
A rough tunnel, narrower and more crudely cut than the catacombs it
leaves. The walls here are bare stone, hacked out with picks and never
dressed. A door stands in the north wall, bound in rusted iron, and the
tunnel returns west to the junction. The floor slopes gently down, and
the damp grows heavier.

4459.name: The Vault

east.description: To the east lies The Junction.

up.description: To the up lies In The Mausoleum.

4459.description:
This vault is older than the cathedral above it, rough-hewn and low,
with the dead laid in stacked stone coffins that crowd the walls. Roots
hang from the ceiling like pale hair. A door leads east to the junction,
and a stair in the corner climbs toward the light of the mausoleum
above. A dry rustling runs through the dark, though nothing stirs.

4460.name: The Vault

north.description: To the north lies The Junction.

up.description: To the up lies In The Mausoleum.

4460.description:
A burial vault of fitted stone, its roof held up by four squat pillars
and its floor inlaid with the names of the dead. Stone sarcophagi stand
along the walls, their lids carved with robed figures whose faces are
worn smooth. A junction opens to the north, and above, a narrow stair
behind an iron door climbs toward the mausoleum. The air smells of
sealed places.

4461.name: The Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies The Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies The Catacombs.

4461.description:
A straight, narrow tunnel, its walls built of grey brick that sweats a
cold moisture. Small niches are cut into the masonry at intervals, each
holding a tarnished lamp of black glass. The passage runs north to a
crossing and south toward a larger gallery. Your footfalls come back
from the dark ahead, always a moment late.

4462.name: The Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies The Tunnel.

east.description: To the east lies The Catacombs.

south.description: To the south lies The Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies The Catacombs.

4462.description:
Four passages of fitted stone cross here beneath a low arched ceiling.
Dust lies undisturbed in the corners, but the middle of the floor is
scuffed in a curious wide band. North and south run narrow tunnels, east
is a burial chamber, and west lies another. A dull iron ring is set in
the ceiling, bearing nothing now.

4463.name: The Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies The Bone Tunnel.

east.description: To the east lies The Catacombs.

south.description: To the south lies The Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies The Catacombs.

4463.description:
A low tunnel of fitted stone runs through the catacombs here, its
ceiling close enough to touch. Burial niches line the walls at the
height of your shoulders, some still holding a wrapped shape. To the
north, a narrow door set in the wall leads to a stranger passage, while
the tunnel runs on south, east and west. The floor is worn into a
shallow trough by countless passing feet.

4464.name: The Catacombs

north.description: To the north lies The Catacombs.

east.description: To the east lies The Tunnel.

4464.description:
The catacomb passage ends here at a wall of bricked-up niches, each
plastered over and marked with a single faded cross. The air is still
and tastes of dust. The passage returns north, and a low tunnel leads
east. Someone has set a line of tiny dry stones along the floor, a
pattern no one living remembers.

4465.name: The Catacombs

north.description: To the north lies The Catacombs.

west.description: To the west lies The Tunnel.

east.description: To the east lies The Sunless Lands.

4465.description:
A corner of the catacombs where the burial niches are stacked three
high, their slabs carved with worn names and faded dates. A faint
trickle of water runs down one wall and pools on the floor in a black,
still mirror. North the passage returns to a wider chamber, and a tunnel
leads west. The cold is bone-deep and utterly still.

4466.name: The Bone Tunnel

south.description: To the south lies The Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies The Bone Tunnel.

4466.description:
Skulls line the walls from floor to ceiling, set in tight rows with
their empty sockets watching the passage. The mortar between them has
crumbled and the whole wall seems to lean toward you. A door to the
south opens back into the main tunnel, and the bone tunnel goes on west.
The cold here has a dry, papery quality, like a held breath.

4467.name: The Bone Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies The T-junction In The Bone Corridor.

east.description: To the east lies The Bone Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies The Small Chamber.

4467.description:
The bone tunnel bends here, its walls built of thigh-bones stacked like
firewood and capped with rows of yellowed skulls. Grit and bone-dust
crunch underfoot. A narrow way leads north toward a junction, and a low
door opens south, while the passage you came by runs back east. Every
breath tastes of lime and old, dry things.

4468.name: The Small Chamber

north.description: To the north lies The Bone Tunnel.

4468.description:
A small chamber off the bone tunnel, hardly wider than a man with
outstretched arms. The ceiling is so low that your head brushes the
cold, damp stone. Someone has scratched crude marks into the wall, long
rows of them, and then gone no further. A narrow door in the north wall
leads back to the tunnel.

4469.name: The Large Cave

south.description: To the south lies The Tunnel.

4469.description:
The tunnel opens into a cavern, its roof lost in blackness and its floor
a litter of broken stone. Stalactites hang from above like rows of
teeth, and a thin, cold wind moves through the dark. The only way out is
the door to the south. Somewhere deep in the rock, water falls in a
slow, steady dripping.

4470.name: The T-junction In The Bone Corridor

east.description: To the east lies The Store.

south.description: To the south lies The Bone Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies The Ossuary.

4470.description:
Three passages meet here in a cramped junction, the walls patterned in
bone as a mason might lay brick. A heavy door of black oak stands in the
east wall, its hinges red with rust, and a wide archway opens west into
a long, low room of piled skulls. The way south leads back down the bone
corridor. A pale chalk mark has been drawn on the lintel and rubbed half
away.

4471.name: The Store

west.description: To the west lies The T-junction In The Bone Corridor.

4471.description:
Narrow shelves line this storeroom from floor to ceiling, crowded with
clay jars sealed in black wax and empty urns without lids. A strong
smell of tallow and mildew lingers in the close air. The only way out is
the door west, which opens upon the bone corridor. Cobwebs hang from the
shelves like grey bunting.

4472.name: The Ossuary

north.description: To the north lies The Room Behind The Door.

east.description: To the east lies The T-junction In The Bone Corridor.

4472.description:
The ossuary is a long vault of stacked bones, thousands of them, sorted
by kind into walls and pillars and tidy pyramids. Skulls gaze from every
ledge and alcove, and a crown of finger-bones is set above the arch like
a decoration. A door in the north wall is closed and heavy with iron
bands, and the junction lies back east. The silence here is the loudest
in the whole place.

4473.name: The Room Behind The Door

south.description: To the south lies The Ossuary.

4473.description:
A small, square room of damp stone, plain after the bone-lined halls
behind. A bare stone bench runs along one wall, and nothing else breaks
the grey. Scratches mark the plaster beside the door, a tally that ends
mid-stroke. The only way out leads south into the ossuary.
